cards.t: Thailand SEC Approves Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs for Stock Exchange of Thailand
cards.b: Thailand's SEC has finalized rules allowing local asset managers to launch spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16, 2026.

per.BTC: Local spot Bitcoin ETFs will begin trading on the Stock Exchange of Thailand on October 16.
per.ETH: Local spot Ether ETFs will launch on the Stock Exchange of Thailand on October 16.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact names of the approved asset management funds and initial asset under management targets.

cards.t: Starknet Considers Transitioning from Layer 2 to Layer 1 Blockchain
cards.b: Starknet announced it is actively considering becoming its own Layer 1 blockchain, aiming to be a fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

per.STRK: Token jumped following the announcement of plans to become an L1 network.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for the mainnet launch of the L1 network and technical architecture details.

cards.t: Solana Narks Final 200-Millisecond Upgrade to Halve Block Times
cards.b: Solana is nearing the completion of its seven-week push to halve block times through a 200-millisecond upgrade, though validators face higher operating costs.

per.SOL: Block times will be halved as the final upgrade nears completion.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact deployment date or block height for the upgrade completion.

cards.t: Sui Protocol Launches Hashi Institutional Bitcoin Lending Protocol
cards.b: Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol backed by $500 million in commitments that allows users to use Bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.

per.SUI: Powering the launch of the new Hashi Bitcoin lending tech.
per.BTC: Holders can use BTC as collateral on other networks via Hashi without moving it off-chain.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact release schedule for public availability.

cards.t: Binance Flags Biconomy and Civic Tokens with Observation Labels and Monitoring Tags
cards.b: Binance has added observation labels and monitoring tags to Biconomy (BICO) and Civic (CVC) tokens due to listing risks and potential delisting evaluation.

per.BICO: Added to Binance's monitoring list due to listing risks.
per.CVC: Added to Binance's monitoring list due to listing risks.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Whether the tokens will ultimately be delisted or removed from observation.
